cells.gaps: The ministry put the register at 9,010,181 people after de-duplicating the 2025 census (GIN-009, July 2025), but the texts constituting it were still in draft in January 2026 (GIN-003) and its extension and verification platform were being launched in September 2026 (GIN-001); no source says it is in service. Nothing says births or deaths are entered in it, or that other systems take records from it.
cells.note: Fact 2025-07-19: the register holds a census-based count, but newer sources still describe it being constituted and extended, so stage 2. Stage 3 needs the register in service.
